Switches

A checkbox styled for binary on / off states.

Switches are checkboxes for on / off. They are CSS only: wrap a checkbox and a span.lever in .switch > label. There is no JavaScript component and nothing to AutoInit. 

<!-- Switch -->
<div class="switch">
  <label>
    Off
    <input type="checkbox">
    <span class="lever"></span>
    On
  </label>
</div>

<!-- Disabled Switch -->
<div class="switch">
  <label>
    Off
    <input type="checkbox" disabled>
    <span class="lever"></span>
    On
  </label>
</div>
